title.narrative: Monitoring & Evaluating CPRGS Implementation in Vietnam Rural Sector

description.narrative: The purpose of the Grant is to assist the Recipient in monitoring adn evaluation of the implementation of its Comprehensive Poverty Reduction and Growth Strategy (CPRGS) in the Rural Sector and to ensure that Government policies and resource allocation in the Rural Sector are more pro-poor. The specific activities (the Activities) for which the Grant is given are as follows: (a) Establishing an operational result-based monitoring system to measure progress in the implementation of the CPRGS in the Rural Sector, including: (i) setting up monitorable indicators and benchmarks for priority outcomes, outputs and inputs required for successful implementation; (ii) reviewing data collection and analysis by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development(MARD) and other agencies; (iii) strengthenning institutional capacity in data collection and analysis as well as communication and dissemination of information on CPRGS implementation; (iv) developing the capacity of policy makers to define their information needs. (b) Strengthenning the institutional capacity of MARD to carry out analyses of the impact of past rural public investments and various policies in support of CPRGS implementation through the provision of technical assistance, training and equipment. To assist the recipient to monitor and evaluate the implementation of its growth and poverty reduction strategy in the rural sector. Main activities include (a) establishing an operational monitoring system to measure the progress of the implementation of the GOVN's Comprehensive Poverty Reduction and Growth Strategy (CPRGS) in the rural sector and (b) strengthenning institutional capacity of MARD to carry out analyses of the impact of rural public investment and policies for poverty reduction. These are supported with the provision of technical assistance, training and equipment. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD) implements this Grant through its Department for Cooperatives and Rural Development (DCRD), which has set up an PMU headed by its Deputy Director. The CPRGS was integrated into Vietnam's Socio-Economic Development Plan (SEDP) for 2006-10 which was approved in 2006 but is still weak in M &E. This makes activity (a) even more actual.
